title: Determination of Phosphorus by Semi-Automated Colorimetry
locator: Sections 1–3, scope and forms of phosphorus. Sections 9 and 11, quality control and procedure.
summary: The color measurement responds to orthophosphate. The sample preparation determines which phosphorus fraction is measured. The agency describes the usable range, calibration checks and how to report the result.
scope: The published method uses a semi-automated manifold and colorimeter for waters and wastes. A benchtop UV–Vis instrument alone does not establish that the lab can reproduce this setup.
rights: Federal agency link and original summary.
